# RNNoise notices

Stream bundles RNNoise neural noise suppression through
`@sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor` 0.4.1. Its MIT license is included as
`LICENSE-MIT-web-noise-suppressor`.

The RNNoise WebAssembly binaries are distributed by the worklet package and
were built with `@shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm` (Apache-2.0). Its license is included
as `LICENSE-APACHE-2.0-rnnoise-wasm`. The underlying RNNoise implementation is
Copyright (c) Jean-Marc Valin, Amazon, Mozilla, Xiph.Org Foundation, and Mark
Borgerding; its BSD-style terms are included as `COPYING-RNNOISE`.

Upstream projects:

- [web-noise-suppressor](https://github.com/sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor)
- [rnnoise-wasm](https://github.com/shiguredo/rnnoise-wasm)
- [RNNoise](https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise)
